name: How do painters protect furniture and floors during interior wall painting?

mainEntity.name: How do painters protect furniture and floors during interior wall painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Protecting floors, furniture, trim, and fixtures is part of a professional interior painting job. A crew should move or cover items carefully, remove or mask hardware as needed, and clean up each day.
acceptedAnswer.description: Good painters should cover floors and furniture, mask fixtures, and handle cleanup so your home stays protected.
